 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Lineups are out! Manuel Neuer starts on the bench today as Bayern rolls out the A-minus (or B-plus) team today against Köln. Jamal Musiala is also back after his injury and joins Tom Bischof, Sacha Boey, and several youth players on the bench.
 Bayern bench:
 Bayern Munich will start its final month of 2026 games with a home league match against FC Köln. It will be the first of eight games in a 29-day window before a very welcome three-week winter break. Bayern will get a few players back from injury but also lost Alphonso Davies to another hamstring injury. Early reports are optimistic on his recovery but Bayern fans will continue to hold their breath on Davies.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement FC Köln continues to play stout defense but the inability to score has the team only two points out of the relegation zone through nine matches. If FC Köln concedes an early goal, it will become a very difficult match for the visiting club.
 SBN App: Engage with match threads on Bavarian Football Works from your phone with the new SB Nation app. Commenting and interacting with your communities is easier than ever before with the Game Chat feature. The app is available currently in the U.S. on iOS and Android devices.
 Prediction
 Bayern wins 3-0. Bayern will dominate from start to finish. Harry Kane will score twice in the first half and Michael Olise will polish it off with a patented left-footed curler in the second half. Bayern will sit on their lead for the final 30 minutes, pinging the ball around a mentally defeated FC Köln side.

 Location: Allianz Arena, Munich, Germany
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Date: Friday, November 20th, 2026
